configs.AUG-1: original train + horizontally flipped copy of every train clip
configs.AUG-2: original train + one light combined augmented copy of every train clip

clip_consistent: one parameter set per clip, applied to all 16 frames
photometric: x' = ((x - clip_mean) * contrast + clip_mean) * brightness, clipped to 0..255
feature_pipeline: augmented 224x224 RGB -> D (crop 180, Haar DWT, 4x4 grid, 5 stats, 320 / frame) -> mean over 16 frames
limitations: augmented clips have no M4 deep features; they only train the DWT-SVM and cannot be used for Handcrafted + Deep per-sample concatenation
